notes.title: Fly Update
notes.content:
I am here again with many updates and innovations. As the first and biggest update, you can now fly anywhere, anytime in the game. I got feedback that the map is too big and you can't go everywhere, Now you can fly wherever you want quickly. To fly, it is enough to jump with the "space" key and press the "space" key again while in the air, and to land, it is enough to press it again.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/60aebdbcd3c46822274a92219350cce829819321.png[/img]

Old bad camera location changed to new location now clearer motion will appear in battles. 

Running animation changed. Old bad animation replaced with new and nicer one and increased character speed.

Targeting added. You can now lock on the target in front of you in battles with holding mouse right click. If there is no target in front of you, it will rotate you relative to the camera. 

Defense button became middle mouse button.

The shield you throw now comes back after a certain time, you don't need to go and get it now.

notes.title: Welcome Menu Update
notes.content:
Added game descriptive Welcome Screen. I saw that the people playing the game were not aware of the features in the game, so I wanted to make the game an explanatory screen. This screen, which appears when you first enter the game, will inform you about the game and features. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/ecb02959f257b13223176f69e84cb660f7efa0ca.png[/img]

Key descriptions on the main screen of the game have been removed and added to the esc menu in detail. You can access this menu from the esc menu and learn all the keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/97e7d6a2e50cba2ad7a0fac6165c0c699035ef24.png[/img]

Added skylights in 7 tradeposts. Added lights to tradeposts where you will improve your character so you can see from afar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/15610192c8cd276b091b16761af5476f0ff7a65b.png[/img]

Weapon trail disabled until reissue.
Some menu bugs fixed.

notes.title: Language Update
notes.content:
You can now play the game in 11 different languages. English, French, Italian, German Spanish, Japanese, Arabic, Korean, Russian, Chinese(simple) and Turkish. You can select the language you want from the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/f08fbd54b4f7ed18b79af937da0d7623b6e6b045.png[/img]

notes.title: Calibur Boss Update
notes.content:
Here is the new boss Calibur. Guardian of the sands. Big, imposing and mighty. You can find it in the desert near the giant tortoise. He has 1750 health point and you can get 6000 points by killing him. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/467311c1eafaf9eb63d0149cc61c04a34993e844.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/1eabc8c46111ee95e21865224d2d536868c49bb1.png[/img]

New forest npc Skeleton. He is fast and not weak at all. He has 150 health point and you can get 125 points by killing him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/482d3a588bf70f26b612d9a8a6cebcc4862d801b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/5f781ac54380a8929e499e9539163328078941f5.png[/img]

Game icon changed. Hope you all like it.

Added "are you sure" phase to home button. So you won't accidentally lose your progress.

notes.title: Map Update
notes.content:
I thought you might have trouble figuring out where the monsters you're going to kill with the quest update are. I made a map showing the regions and the location of the monsters to help. You can press "m" key to open the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/cc2b34dabb9f62bf9945a532e4b32f7eff16272c.png[/img]

Added a close hud button to the game. You can press "F10" key to close hud and press again to open the hud. So you can get better view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573070/4c5ed04d934cbcdfd8399f86a268fcdd55fc9f00.png[/img]

Added a small camera movement in the first entry of the game. So you can see and know your surroundings at the entrance of the game.

Fixed some menu bugs.

notes.title: Quests Update
notes.content:
As it is known, you need to kil monsters and collect points to upgrade your character or open new spells. Killing monsters with a weak character at the beginning of the game can be boring. So i made an update with several quests giving abundant prizes. The quests are pretty simple. If you kill as many monsters as it wants you to kill, you will get your prize. The reward increases with each mission.
